fusions.name: Midnight Yowl
fusions.desc: Yowls a cone of sound 3 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Dusk Swoop
fusions.desc: Swoops up to 6 tiles onto an enemy at or below 30% health and bites it for 22 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.4 times their remaining damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Rafter Flit
fusions.desc: Flits up to 6 tiles to where you aim. You also gain 6% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Lapping Tongue
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your attacks heal you for 20% of the damage they deal for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
